label: PORTFOLIO / LAB
content:
// Entra sign-in failures. Requires SigninLogs in the workspace.
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where ResultType != 0
| summarize
    Failures = count(),
    Users = dcount(UserPrincipalName),
    SampleErrors = make_set(ResultDescription, 5)
    by UserPrincipalName, AppDisplayName, IPAddress, ResultType
| order by Failures desc
| take 50
